facts.text: Eight-panel vertical character reference sheet: a large cinematic hero image at top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle row, and four close-up detail panels at the bottom.
The character is an adult male with East Asian facial features, short dark hair shaved at the sides with a small topknot, and a diagonal scar through his right eyebrow on the viewer's left.
He wears an all-black outfit: a high-collared tactical jacket with strap and metal buckle details, a dark shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.

In the hero panel he stands upright with arms at his sides on a rain-soaked walkway with metal railings, looking up and to the viewer's left; dark buildings and warm city lights are behind him in the rain.
The middle row shows the same character full-body against a dark gray studio-like background in front view, left-facing side profile, and rear view.
The bottom row contains close-ups of his face with a neutral direct gaze, the jacket collar with strap and buckle, two hands with visible skin texture, and black leather combat boots.
White uppercase labels identify the panels: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

limitations: Rain, darkness, and shallow depth of field obscure some background detail in the hero panel.
The close-up panels show only portions of the figure.
